h:
快速将视觉和音频转换为智能、连贯的文本输出。

适合谁：希望在 ComfyUI 中使用此管道而无需从头开始组装节点的创建者。不适合：零调整的一键结果 - 您仍然可以选择输入、提示和设置。

在 RunComfy 上打开预加载的工作流程

在 RunComfy（浏览器）上打开预加载的工作流程

为什么首先选择 RunComfy
- 更少的丢失节点意外- 在本地镜像之前，在托管环境中运行该图。
- GPU 快速试用- 如果您的本地 VRAM 或安装时间是瓶颈，则非常有用。
- 与发布的 JSON 匹配- 该 zip 遵循与您可以在 RunComfy 上打开的相同的可运行工作流程。

当下载本地 ComfyUI 有意义时- 您想要完全控制磁盘上的模型、批处理脚本或离线运行。

使用方法（本地ComfyUI）
1. 在标记的加载器节点中加载输入（图像/视频/音频）。
2、设置提示、分辨率、种子；从短暂的试运行开始。
3. 从图中所示的保存/写入节点导出。

期望- 第一次运行可能会拉动大重量;云运行可能需要免费的 RunComfy 帐户.

概述

此工作流程使您能够在视觉、音频和视频提示的引导下创建连贯的文本输出。您可以分析媒体、总结评论或通过准确的上下文基础构建轻量级聊天机器人原型。它无缝集成了用于文本、CLIP 和转录任务的 ComfyUI 节点。该设置提高了法学硕士测试和多模式研究的效率。非常适合寻求快速、上下文感知的 AI 文本生成的设计人员和开发人员。

重要节点：

Comfyui Gemma 4 文本生成 ComfyUI 工作流程中的关键节点

  • 文本生成(#1)
    驱动最终输出，是大多数调音的地方。通过更改最大标记和采样温度来调整响应的长度以及探索性的感觉。如果您希望在得出答案之前进行更多逐步思考，请启用可选推理模式。实现细节参见ComfyUI文本生成节点源码这里.

  • 剪辑加载器(#3)
    选择并加载文本和多模式理解所需的 Gemma 4 E4B 编码器包。如果您在本地维护模型，请将文件放置在：
    ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/gemma4_e4b_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors
    选择后，您很少需要重新访问此节点，除非您切换模型变体。

  • 获取视频组件(#7)
    当您希望模型考虑视频时很有用。它公开帧和音频，以便您可以调节文本生成两者上。如果您的剪辑很长，请选择较小的一组帧以加快周转速度；如果您需要更精细的细节，请以速度为代价增加帧采样。

注释

Gemma 4 文本生成 ComfyUI 工作流程 |图文音频分析工具- 参见舒适运行页面了解最新的节点要求。

o.en:
Transforms visuals and audio into intelligent, coherent text outputs fast.

Who it's for:creators who want this pipeline in ComfyUI without assembling nodes from scratch.Not for:one-click results with zero tuning - you still choose inputs, prompts, and settings.

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy (browser)

Why RunComfy first
- Fewer missing-node surprises- run the graph in a managed environment before you mirror it locally.
- Quick GPU tryout- useful if your local VRAM or install time is the bottleneck.
- Matches the published JSON- the zip follows the same runnable workflow you can open on RunComfy.

When downloading for local ComfyUI makes sense- you want full control over models on disk, batch scripting, or offline runs.

How to use (local ComfyUI)
1. Load inputs (images/video/audio) in the marked loader nodes.
2. Set prompts, resolution, and seeds; start with a short test run.
3. Export from the Save / Write nodes shown in the graph.

Expectations- First run may pulllarge weights; cloud runs may require afree RunComfy account.

Overview

This workflow empowers you to create coherent text outputs guided by visual, audio, and video cues. You can analyze media, summarize reviews, or prototype lightweight chatbots with accurate context grounding. It integrates ComfyUI nodes for text, CLIP, and transcription tasks seamlessly. The setup boosts efficiency in LLM testing and multimodal research. Ideal for designers and developers seeking fast, context-aware AI text generation.

Important nodes:

Key nodes in Comfyui Gemma 4 Text Generation ComfyUI workflow

  • TextGenerate(#1)
    Drives the final output and is where most tuning lives. Adjust how long the response can be and how exploratory it should feel by changing the maximum tokens and sampling temperature. Enable the optional reasoning mode if you want more step‑by‑step thinking before the answer. For implementation details, see the ComfyUI text generation node source codehere.

  • CLIPLoader(#3)
    Selects and loads the Gemma 4 E4B encoder package needed for text and multimodal understanding. If you maintain models locally, place the file under:
    ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/gemma4_e4b_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors
    After selection, you rarely need to revisit this node unless you switch model variants.

  • GetVideoComponents(#7)
    Useful when you want the model to consider video. It exposes frames and audio so you can conditionTextGenerateon both. If your clip is long, choose a smaller set of frames for faster turnaround; if you need finer detail, increase the frame sampling at the cost of speed.
